name: With Ribbon
source:
This is HULOTTE’s debut title. Shoutarou had a dream where a young girl he had never seen before leapt at him, saying that she finally found him and she had wanted to meet her father. She said that even though he’s not her father yet right now, he definitely will be. With a kind smile, she tells him that he will understand what she’s saying soon. After waking up, he walks to Tokimizu Academy like usual with his childhood friend Hina and saves a girl from being hit by a car. It’s the same girl from his dream! “I’ve come to support your love, papa!”

[Edited from [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2011/02/13/february-2011-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
這是HULOTTE的出道作品。翔太郎夢見一個素未謀面的年幼少女撲向自己，說終於找到他了，而且一直想見到自己的父親。少女說，雖然他現在還不是她的父親，將來卻一定會成為。她帶著溫柔的笑容告訴他，很快就會明白這些話的含義。醒來後，他像往常一樣與青梅竹馬陽菜走路前往時水學園，途中救下一名險些被汽車撞到的少女。她竟然正是夢裡的那個女孩！「爸爸，我是來為你的戀情加油的！」

[改寫自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2011/02/13/february-2011-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
